newsitem.title: LATVIA: VALMIERA SAYS TO MEET YR FORECAST IN 6-MO.
newsitem.headline: VALMIERA SAYS TO MEET YR FORECAST IN 6-MO.

text.p: Valmiera Glassfibre factory said on Friday that it sees its 1997 profit forecast of 600,000 lats fulfilled in six months.

"We expect the second quarter profit to be no less than the 260,000 lats of the first quarter, which means that Valmiera could make its forecast 1997 figure of 600,000 lats in the half-year," Imants Saulitis, finance manager of the company, told Reuters.
"Valmiera turnover in the second quarter came to 5.26 million lats, slightly above plan," Saulitis said.
Valmiera has earlier set a 1997 turnover target of 10.41 million lats.

Saulitis also said a company board meeting, which will last into the weekend after starting on Thursday, still has to finalise an agreement to invest equipment worth 900,000 lats by strategic investor Glasseiden Oschatz.

Under the deal with the privatisation agency, Glasseiden, which has a 49 percent stake, has to carry out investment worth 13 million lats over five years, 3.9 million lats of the sum in cash. Three million lats of the cash investment has to be completed by the end of 1998.
